name: Small Industries Unit for Persons with Disabilities
benefit: 1. Under this scheme, loan assistance of up to ₹25,00,000/- is provided to differently-abled persons for setting up manufacturing, fabrication, and production units.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%.
   1. The applicant should be over 18 years old. For persons with mental retardation, the age requirement is relaxed to 14 years instead of the usual 18 years.
